newsitem.title: USA: Clean Harbors outlook rvsd to negative - S&P.
newsitem.headline: Clean Harbors outlook rvsd to negative - S&P.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said it revised its outlook on Clean Harbors Inc to negative from stable and has affirmed its single-B-plus corporate credit and single-B senior unsecured note ratings.
S&P said the outlook revision, made on Monday, reflects concerns that continuing weak operating performance is likley to adversely affect credit quality.

"The Braintree, Mass-based company carries high business risk as a niche supplier in the difficult hazardous waste management industry, and a weak financial position based on a stretched capital structure and thin cash flow protection," S&P said.
A downgrade could follow should the company fail to improve operating results and strengthen cash flow in the next year, the agency added.
